DAILY PROTOCOLS
🎯
VISUALIZATION
DAILY · PRE-TRAINING · 10 MIN
✓
Close eyes. 4-7-8 breath × 3 cycles. Full body release.
✓
See the court — full sensory detail. Crowd noise, hardwood, lights.
✓
Execute your signature move — perfect form, perfect result.
✓
Replay from defensive scenario — react, dominate, win.
✓
See yourself healthy, explosive, fully trusted in your Achilles.
✓
Anchor with physical cue — fist clench. Lock it in.
🧠
BOX BREATHING
PRE-SESSION · PRE-GAME · 5 MIN
✓
Seated — spine tall, shoulders down and back.
✓
INHALE through nose — 4 full counts. Belly fills first.
✓
HOLD — 4 counts. Full tension. Don't strain.
✓
EXHALE through mouth — 4 counts. Complete release.
✓
HOLD empty — 4 counts. Zero breath. Controlled calm.
✓
Repeat × 4 cycles. CNS optimal state achieved.
🔥

WEEKLY · JOURNAL · 15 MIN
✓

✓
WED — Mid-week audit. What's working? What needs adjusting?
✓
FRI — Write identity statement: "I am __. I trust my body."
✓
SAT — Film study + mental visualization of top plays.
✓
SUN — Recovery reflection. Rate sleep, energy, mindset 1–10.
✓
Theme: "I TRUST MY BODY FULLY." Say it daily.
